sourceReasons.data/blok_a_strecha.pac: Corrugated/sheet pattern and dark rectangular hatch/edge details; substrate/coating and possible opening boundaries are not independently established. Not a whole rough-dielectric source.
sourceReasons.data/blok_a_strecha_02.pac: Low-resolution mottled flat sheet with several dark rectangular patches. Roofing substrate, patch/hatch identity and baked shading are unresolved; opacity is not physical evidence.
sourceReasons.data/dum_05_strecha_01.pac: Low-resolution roof photograph includes a large dark rectangle and smaller adjacent square. Openings/patches cannot inherit a rough roof declaration from their surroundings.
sourceReasons.data/garaz_strecha.pac: Weathered corrugated sheet; metallic substrate versus paint/oxidation is not separately encoded. Do not infer optical coefficients from rust color or the roof filename.
sourceReasons.data/hang_strecha.pac: Seamed sheet roof with variable worn coating/rust; no separable optical evidence for bare versus coated sheet. Retain original response.
sourceReasons.data/hang_strecha_kraj.pac: Seamed roof edge includes folded/edge and coated/oxidized sheet detail; not a dedicated tile/masonry image.
sourceReasons.data/hruzdum_strecha.pac: Photographed tiled roof includes pale perimeter and lower ground/debris. U .04...96 / V .04...88 excludes those margins but contains no complete otherwise-eligible original triangle; broad faces cross the boundary.
sourceReasons.data/kdomek_komin.pac: Narrow masonry/chimney photograph includes upper/lower dark cap/support detail. U 0..1 / V .18...91 contains no complete otherwise-eligible original triangle. No triangle clipping or guessed cap class.
sourceReasons.data/kdomek_podkomin.pac: Small dark roof/support patch; flashing, coating and roofing substrate cannot be identified independently at this source resolution.
sourceReasons.data/komin.pac: Tiny top image contains a dark square aperture. The apparent cap and hole remain distinct unresolved physical regions, not a whole-source material.
sourceReasons.data/komin_maly_side_01.pac: Central chimney strip shares an image with flat background/margins. Exploratory U .23...72 / V .05...98 admits only near-LOD horizontal detail/caps, not the full body. Body boundaries and normal-view value remain a pending region review.
sourceReasons.data/komin_roura_side.pac: Narrow shaded tube with a dark top lip; ceramic versus metal/coating is not established by the source image. Preserve original response.
sourceReasons.data/komin_roura_top.pac: Dark round aperture with blurred rim/background. A black hole is not a rough solid receiver.
sourceReasons.data/komin_side_af.pac: Very low-resolution shaded chimney photograph with dark edge/base transitions. Possible rough plaster body is a follow-up candidate, but original whole-face physical boundaries and normal-view value are not yet established.
sourceReasons.data/komin_top_01.pac: Large photographed black hole and rim/background. Most placed chimney users do not justify promoting the hole or guessing a cap material.
sourceReasons.data/kostel2_strecha2.pac: Repeated blue roof covering; the original small image alone does not distinguish tile/slate from painted metal imitation. No class from color or repeated grooves.
sourceReasons.data/kostel2_strecha3.pac: Repeated narrow blue roof covering with unresolved substrate/coating, matching the related church source uncertainty.
sourceReasons.data/kostel2_strecha_veze.pac: Photographed tapered spire includes blue background, dark aperture and bright lower architectural band. Not a single physical source; whole triangles need separate boundary review.
sourceReasons.data/kostel2_strecha_vezi.pac: Small spire photograph includes surrounding flat blue background and dark/shaded details. No whole-source declaration.
sourceReasons.data/kostel2_strecha_zakr.pac: Triangular roof photograph includes surrounding background and dark lower band. Original image/geometry do not justify a full-image homogeneous roof class.
sourceReasons.data/kostel_strecha.pac: Approved dedicated overlapping rounded roof tiles. Entire original source repeats the same rough dielectric material; original colors, photographed dirt and shadows remain.
sourceReasons.data/kostel_t_strecha.pac: Mottled dark roofing with no independent substrate evidence; felt, sheet/coating and weathering cannot be disambiguated. Existing authored-lighting triangles stay rejected.
sourceReasons.data/strazni_vez_strecha_.pac: Mottled weathered surface without independent optical substrate evidence. A roof filename and mottled color do not establish wood, tile or bare/coated metal.
sourceReasons.data/strecha_tasky.pac: Approved dedicated overlapping rounded roof tiles, with original varied colors/weathering. Repeating UVs stay within this physical class.
sourceReasons.o/hous/chata6strecha.pac: Diamond roof tiles share an atlas with horizontal/vertical border strips. Tile substrate versus painted sheet and edge/flashing boundaries remain unresolved, not whole-image approval.
sourceReasons.o/hous/hasicakstrecha.pac: Approved dedicated overlapping curved roof tiles. Shared fire-station and gate-cap users repeat the same material; no window/door/metal source inherits this identity.
sourceReasons.o/hous/kostel02_strechal.pac: Rough weathered rectangular roof units are a follow-up physical candidate, but substrate/coating and sampled original face context still need normal-gameplay acceptance. Not implemented or counted as completed optical review.
sourceReasons.o/hous/orlhot_kom.pac: Brick/mortar strip shares an atlas with left frame/panel and right black recess. U .22...79 / V 0..1 selects complete original brick faces in 13 models with no partial fans; these are actionable pending region candidates, not a whole-image declaration or completed implementation.
sourceReasons.o/hous/panel_strecha.pac: Weathered green flat surface; possible coating/oxidation and sheet substrate are not independently encoded. No inferred metallic or dielectric class from green color.
sourceReasons.o/hous/posed_strecha.pac: Cracked bark/rough covering photograph includes ragged perimeter/background. Whole-image material approval would also adopt the edge/support photograph; physical/UV boundaries remain pending.
sourceReasons.o/hous/radnice_strecha.pac: Standing-seam roof with stained coating/oxidized sheet detail. No independent bare-metal/coating optical separation; retain original source response.
